# Worker assignment: finish the executable policy cycle and run it live

This is a complete assignment for a fresh worker chat. Start from the pushed branch `codex/stage-09-consolidation-review`, which includes implementation `efe73a3` and its review. Create your integration branch `codex/implementation-stage-09-completion` from that tip. Use the configured `origin`; do not invent or copy remote addresses. Commit as `Nightjar <nightjar@authors.invalid>`. Additive commits and push are authorized; no force push, history rewrite or automatic merge into another owner's branch.

## Objective and reading order

Finish the existing stage 9 contract, not another framework or a broad bug hunt. A persistent investigation must execute a learning policy, acquire/use task methods, learn from allowed operational feedback, propose an executable policy revision, assess it independently, bind or reject it, and continue in a fresh process. Then run one bounded prospective P0/P1/P2 live study. A well-supported negative is a completed study. General learning advantage is not required or assumed.

Read these committed files before planning:

1. `AGENTS.md`, `IMPLEMENTATION-WORKFLOW.md`, `COLLABORATION.md`.
2. `docs/design/REFINEMENT-ROADMAP.md` and its generality checkpoint; `docs/design/ARCHITECTURAL-DIRECTION-2026-09-17.md`.
3. `docs/design/STAGE-09-IMPLEMENTATION-CONTRACT.md` N1–N6, then `WORKER-STAGE-09-CONSOLIDATION.md` M0–M7. This completion assignment supplies the new authority and addresses missed connections; it does not waive those contracts.
4. `reviews/STAGE-09-EFE73A3-ASSESSMENT.md`, its controller probe and Jev evidence.
5. `reports/STAGE-09-CONSOLIDATION.md`, workstreams `s09-m1`, `s09-m2`, `s09-m34`, `s09-m5`, and relevant production callers/tests.

The product remains general autonomous investigation and executable improvement across domains. Current software and constraint-reduction tasks are instruments. Keep stage 8 accepted at scope and `evidence_inv01_live/` byte-identical. Preserve prior fixture bundles as historical evidence. Work on material behavior, conclusions and reproducibility; ledger unrelated minor issues.

## C0 — Establish the complete integration contract

Maintain `reports/PLAN.md` with C0–C6, S9R-01–04, dependencies, owners, public commands and acceptance gates. Independently confirm or rebut each review finding using source or a reproducer. Do not blindly obey a reviewer; a rebuttal must demonstrate the required behavior through the real caller.

Before splitting work, fix the shared meanings of investigation ID, policy source/version, STEP state, accepted action, pending effect, method artifact, revision proposal, assessment and active binding. Map each action to its executing function and resulting durable evidence. Identify exactly who consumes operational feedback, who constructs STEP bytes, and who independently qualifies promotion. Reuse the existing broker, storage and child facilities. Avoid adapters that merely rename the old method experiment as a policy experiment.

Have an independent reviewer challenge this plan against the original contract, not your implementation summary. Use Jev as specified below. Close incompatible contracts before parallel implementation. You may make substantial necessary changes to the current driver; implementation convenience is not a reason to narrow the behavior.

## C1 — Make STEP state and every action real

Complete S9R-02 in the current shared driver. Preserve private policy state, last effect result and remaining resources across action boundaries and fresh-process resume. Persist the selected policy identity, state transition and attributable pending action before effects. Resume the same operation instead of drawing a new model response or rerunning construction. Include exhausted and refused paths in durable history.

Enforce at most six policy steps and six total model calls per episode as cumulative limits, not six per call to `decide`. Model requests, initial construction, repair, empty output and provider failures consume their proper allowances. Reconciliation must include pending exposure and prevent concurrent/resumed allowance reuse. A settled receipt must remain attributable even if decoding fails.

Implement the distinct semantics of diagnose, construct_method, use_method, request_model, propose_revision and stop. `use_method` resolves and executes the requested eligible method bytes; it cannot silently turn into construction. `propose_revision` enters the trusted revision process or leaves an explicit durable refusal, rather than stopping with unused metadata. Accepted effects return observations to the next STEP. Keep untrusted policy/candidate code in bounded child execution.

Required counterchecks: allowance=1 followed by repeated model requests; state changed before another boundary; fresh-process death/resume between decision, preparation, receipt and continuation; a policy requesting only retained use with the constructor disconnected; a policy requesting revision with a disconnected constructor; exhausted steps and no further effects. Use independently supplied STEP bytes and real children/PostgreSQL for final acceptance. The committed reviewer diagnostic has doubled boundaries; convert the defect into maintained behavioral gates instead of counting its exit 0 as success.

## C2 — Close revision, qualification and exact subsequent selection

Complete S9R-03/04. Allowed operational feedback must be sufficient for the runtime to create a revision request and construct new `kind=learning-policy`, `entry=STEP` bytes with parent lineage. Task-method acquisition remains separate. Freeze candidate bytes before sealed assessment exposure. Bind only a qualifying, current assessment for those exact bytes, protocol, evaluator and scope, inside the trusted promotion path. Caller-supplied labels or empty evidence references cannot authorize a learned release. Keep explicit authored-incumbent initialization separate.

Carry the investigation's binding identity through the public command, exports and fresh-process continuation. Do not resolve a binding by whichever unrelated same-family release is globally newest. Preserve atomic stale-update refusal, revocation/fallback behavior and exposure retirement. Feedback for future revisions cannot contain protected assessment answers or promote retired tasks back to unseen evidence.

Required counterchecks: absent/failed/stale/wrong-source/wrong-scope assessment; concurrent binding replacement; two independent studies with overlapping families; explicit pinned public use after restart; protected-answer perturbation leaving construction inputs unchanged; rejected revision retaining the incumbent. Produce a complete deterministic acquire/check/retain/use/revise/assess/bind-or-reject/continue run from one public command, including an honest no-candidate run. Tests may supply a provider double; they must not manually perform the missing lifecycle between commands.

## C3 — Run the actual prospective policy experiment with controlled providers

Complete S9R-01 and N5. P0 is the frozen incumbent STEP policy. P1 constructs a STEP policy from objective/interface without an experience corpus. P2 gets the same interface and allowance plus permitted development experience. P1/P2 sources must be returned constructor bytes; compare executed digests to those bytes. Feed permitted experience without authored strategy menus or protected answers. All arms use the same driver, execution profile, admissible actions and assessment rules.

Keep the N5 schedule: at most four visible development episodes, two per domain; one policy candidate plus one repair for P1 and for P2; twelve matched assessment episodes over two fresh worlds per domain and three arms; two sealed method-use tasks per assessment episode, one in scope and one structural variation. Make the assessment tasks genuinely absent from construction/development exposure. Do not replace failed episodes, turn unavailable arms into the incumbent, or change a panel after seeing its outcomes.

Freeze identities, source/configuration, order, budgets and quality/resource rule before assessment. Use a finite rule without dividing by zero. Record construction delivery, executable validity, changed decisions/effects, downstream task utility and complete resource cost separately. A changed digest alone proves none of those benefits. Report P2 against P0 and P1 separately; incomplete coverage cannot earn a full comparison verdict.

Wire live configuration to the real provider adapter. Prove selection with a controlled HTTP provider and a deliberately different returned STEP policy; a live-mode flag must not retain an in-process recording gateway. Prove constructor disconnect yields no candidate and zero authored substitution. Offline exports must reconstruct membership, source lineage, effects, receipts, full accounting and verdicts without a provider or live database. Delete or alter a record and require a specific verifier failure.
